summary: Upstream Bio filed a Form 8-K furnishing a September 1, 2026 press release under Items 7.01 and 8.01 announcing pivotal Phase 3 development plans for verekitug in severe asthma and chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps. The company disclosed a single high-dose 400mg subcutaneous regimen administered every 12 weeks and two placebo-controlled trials enrolling roughly 1,500 patients combined, with 48-week primary endpoints of annualized asthma exacerbation rates and co-primary nasal polyp and congestion score changes. Phase 3 initiation is expected in Q1 2027, with a potential BLA and launch as early as 2030. No deal, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or special-situation mechanics are stated; this is a routine clinical-update disclosure rather than a transactional event, so the risk-arb angle is limited to pipeline and timeline uncertainty.
